name: LinkedIn Profile Analysis - QA Engineer
description: Signal extraction rules for LinkedIn profiles of QA Engineers and Test Automation Specialists. NOTE: Specific evidence mappings (regex patterns and maps_to composite keys) are stored within individual skill files under evidence.linkedin, NOT here. The validate_composite_keys.py script scans both locations to verify coverage.

quality_indicators: Demonstrated career progression from manual QA to test automation architecture
Specific automation frameworks mentioned (Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, REST Assured)
Performance testing and CI/CD test pipeline ownership

skills_endorsements.notes: Endorsements provide soft validation. High endorsement count (>10) increases confidence.

quality_indicators: Recommendations from engineering managers or product managers praising defect detection accuracy and release velocity
Peer reviews highlighting reduction in test flakiness and reliable automation pipelines

patterns.pattern: Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium Automation endorsed
Manual Testing, Test Planning, or STLC endorsed
API Testing, Postman, or REST Assured endorsed
Performance Testing, JMeter, or k6 endorsed
TestRail, JIRA, or Quality Assurance Leadership endorsed
Accessibility Testing, WCAG, or A11y mentioned
Contract Testing, Pact, or WireMock mentioned

important_notes: LinkedIn endorsements without repository evidence receive moderate weight (0.3 - 0.5)
Differentiate QA roles from customer support or general IT positions using job descriptions and technology keywords
